purpose: Test whether V7 recommendation-order-induced agent choice divergence survives action writeback as measurable next-task recommendation exposure divergence.
studyRole: Deterministic mediator bridge between the completed V7 action experiment and a prospective downstream-agent experiment.
claimBoundary: The study tests a one-step feedback path inside a research storefront: learned recommendation order changes provider output, and writing that output to the same frozen recommender changes a later slate. It does not establish purchases, human behavior, a production-retailer loop, long-run amplification, or welfare effects.

sampling.frame: All 460 frozen tasks crossed with SASRec and GRU4Rec; no conditioning on whether a V7 action diverged.
sampling.dependence: Resample tasks within category, retaining both recommender families, both action-source providers, and both instrument modes in each task cluster.

writeback.selectedAction: Append the selected pseudonymous candidate's underlying catalog item to the principal history; append nothing for abandon.
writeback.nextTaskEvent: Append the task's held-out chronological next item after the selected action as a standardized first event for the next task.
writeback.checkpoint: Use the same frozen recommender family and seed assigned to the V7 unit; do not retrain.
writeback.candidateMask: Use one condition-invariant mask per provider-mode-unit: prior interacted items, the held-out next-task event, and the union of all four selected writeback items.

estimand.energyFormula: 2 * mean(distance(immediate replicate, held replicate) over four cross-arm pairs) - distance(immediate-a, immediate-b) - distance(held-a, held-b)
estimand.primary: DeepSeek served-order downstream slate energy displacement.
estimand.negativeControl: DeepSeek masked-control downstream slate energy displacement.
estimand.robustness: MiMo and recommender-family estimates are reported separately without provider pooling.
supporting: fraction of units with any matched cross-arm next-slate change
mean matched cross-arm top-10 set displacement
fraction of units with a changed top-ranked item
fraction of units with a cross-arm selected-action difference

feedbackExposureGate.instrument: Every selected alias maps to exactly one private catalog item; every slate has ten unique items; all four conditions use an identical mask.
feedbackExposureGate.primary: DeepSeek served-order lower 95% bound is above zero.
feedbackExposureGate.negativeControl: DeepSeek masked-control upper 95% bound is below 0.02.
feedbackExposureGate.recurrence: SASRec and GRU4Rec served-order point estimates are both above zero.
feedbackExposureGate.decision: All four requirements must pass before any new downstream-agent API calls.

stopRules.noFeedback: If the primary lower bound is not above zero, do not claim a measurable recommendation feedback path.
stopRules.unstableControl: If the masked-control upper bound is at least 0.02, treat provider-output noise as unresolved and do not proceed to downstream-agent calls.
stopRules.modelSpecific: If either recommender-family point estimate is non-positive, report model dependence and do not call the bridge general across the two learned recommenders.
